anything else.

][84]

As part of its integrated biodiversity conservation programme, ITC spearheaded a unique initiative
in Andhra Pradesh that spans mangrove restoration and sea turtle hatchling conservation,
demonstrating the impact of community-led ecological interventions.

][87]
[

ITC has built a comprehensive and vibrant Agri-ecosystem that is empowering Indian farmers to grow
high-value spices and increase their incomes through access to superior advisory, technological
inputs, traceability and global market access.

][88]
[
ITCMAARS 'Crop Doctor' enables farmers to improve plant health across 70 crops

ITC’s AI- and ML-powered agritech solution is enabling real-time detection of plant diseases,
delivering tailored remedial guidance to Indian farmers.

Sanjiv Puri, Chairman and Managing Director of ITC, is betting on India’s long runway for growth to

consumption trends, and growth drivers across different business segments...

][91]
[
24 Mantra Organic & ITC: Shaping the future of India's organic food industry

“ITC’s acquisition of 24 Mantra Organic is aimed at not only strengthening the brand’s presence in
the high-growth organic foods space but also fuel the overall segment growth and increase exports of
organic food out of India”, said Anuj Rustagi, Chief Executive, Staples, Foods Division, ITC.

][92]
[
ITC targets leadership in FMCG; portfolio expansion, premiumisation to drive growth: CMD Sanjiv Puri

ITC is sharpening its focus on becoming a leader in the FMCG space, with portfolio expansion and
premiumisation set to drive the next phase of growth, said Sanjiv Puri, Chairman & Managing
Director, ITC, in an exclusive interview to CNBC-TV18.

][93]

This International Day of Potato, we celebrate the journey of the potato! ITC is a part of every
step of its value chain, from the seed to the snacks you love!

ITC FMCG Recent Launches - Q3 FY2026

From indulgent bites to everyday essentials, ITC’s FMCG portfolio continues to grow with new

crafted to meet evolving consumer needs across categories

][95]

ITC Spices recently concluded its participation at the International Spice Conference 2026, held
from 23rd to 26th February in Cochin.

Congratulations to Team ITC Hotels for being recognized as the World’s Leading Sustainable

ITC’s Trade Marketing & Distribution Division won multiple awards at the CII-IQ Digital

# Product Portfolio

Ashton Distributors is home to three leading premium cigar brands: Ashton, La Aroma de Cuba, and San
Cristobal. We are among the top purveyors of handmade cigars in the world. Our brands are sold in
the finest retail cigar shops in over 75 countries. In addition, our company manufactures and
distributes a full suite of Savoy Humidors & Accessories.

[Learn More][22]

# Company History

Ashton was founded in 1985 by Robert Levin in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. Levin created the company
following several successful years as a premium cigar retailer. A focus on quality, tradition, and
longevity has been a priority from day one. Ashton has grown steadily and significantly over the
past forty years and is home to several classic cigars today.

[Learn More][23]

# Giving Back

Strong roots connect us to our home and headquarters in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. Our heritage in
the premium cigar industry began here in 1898. As long-standing members of the local community, we
believe strongly in giving back. Our philanthropic efforts include supporting many local charities
